column1: # Data sources axis: PROVENANCE -- MULTI-VALUED.
# Principle of division: BY WHAT MECHANISM the signal's values were produced.
# NOT what the signal is a record of (that is the `referent` axis), not who
# collected or redistributed it, not the modality, not the task, not how it is
# accessed, and NOT what the content depicts -- subject matter is `domains`.
# REWRITTEN 2026-10-08 by the owner's decision to split mechanism from referent
# (SYNTHESIS.md section 7). The axis previously asked both questions at once and
# the three phase-2 placement runs hit it from three different rows: `simulated`
# demanded an engine with physical units AND a real referent, which 38-44% of
# placed names could not both satisfy; `natural` judged the SUBJECT rather than
# the signal, so a street-sign corpus failed its test; and `rule` swung 4x in
# count depending on whether a game's observations or its rewards were read.
# All three referent derivations collapsed the same values, independently.
# MULTI-VALUED means a source may carry SEVERAL values at once. A clinical
# record is both an instrument's measurement of a body and a record of clinical
# activity, and both values hold. All three phase-2 runs read the old
# fastMRI/MIMIC rows as a contradiction, so it is said here.
# NOT a node: a byproduct-of-operation value. Run B of phase 1 proposed one
# (`operational`), run A three, run C none; the owner adopted run C's fold into
# human authorship on 2026-10-08, FLAGGED TO WATCH. Its instrument is NOT a
# residual count on this axis -- `operational_sweep.tsv` names the 34 candidates
# and their three families outright, which survives this rewrite. See
# SYNTHESIS.md sections 2 and 7.
# `unknown` is a CODING STATE, not a node. An empty value set means "nothing
# applies", never "nobody looked".
node_id
measured
column4: the values are produced by an instrument transducing a physical state of the world
column5: the values come off a sensor or assay, and swapping the instrument changes the values while no one chooses any of them
column6: fails when a person authored the content and the instrument only transported it -- photographing a page records the page, not the world
column7: SDSS and LSST survey imaging; fastMRI raw k-space; Sentinel-2 imagery; GTSRB and Duckietown camera frames; MIMIC vital-sign waveforms; machine telemetry and cluster traces
column8: RENAMED from `natural`, and its old positive test ("remove every human purpose and the process still runs") DELETED. That clause judged the subject, not the signal, so it expelled its own exemplars -- all three phase-2 runs reported it and run A found it false of fastMRI, which the old table listed here. A camera pointed at a human artifact is still a camera. Whether the thing measured is natural or man-made is `domains`, and how answerable the values are is `referent`

column1: human-authored
column4: a person composed, wrote, drew or judged the content itself
column5: remove the person and there is no content, only a blank; the signal is the artifact of a human act, not a reading taken of one
column6: fails when an instrument produced the values and a human merely chose where to point it (measured); fails when a program computed them
column7: Common Crawl and Wikipedia text; The Stack / GitHub code; Project Gutenberg; ImageNet class labels; MIMIC clinical notes and orders; Criteo click logs; MovieLens ratings
column8: RENAMED from `human-incidental` and widened to cover both the incidental and the elicited cases, because the old pair divided on WHY the content exists rather than on who produced it -- which is a collection channel, not a mechanism. Absorbs the byproduct-of-operation fold: a clinician, a clicker and a rater are each authoring, and the record is collected afterwards

column1: elicited
column4: the content exists because the collection asked for it; a person or animal produced it to the collection's protocol
column5: there is a task description, protocol, prompt or payment that caused each item to be produced; remove the research request and the content does not exist
column6: repurposed pre-existing human material stays plain `human-authored` however aggressively it was filtered -- selection is not origination
column7: MS COCO annotations; SQuAD and SNLI; HH-RLHF preference comparisons; teleoperated robot demonstrations; Neural Latents Benchmark macaque recordings
column8: KEPT AS A CHILD, and the one place this axis uses `parents`. The three referent runs split 3 ways on it: D1 deadlocked (the 3/3 rule forbids deleting it, a strict mechanism reading forbids keeping it), D2 kept it as a labelled lodger and named what it really is -- run C's predicted collection-channel axis -- and D3 made it a child because "the child does carry a real extra fact". Two of three keep it, so it is kept, as a child, labelled. WIDENED earlier from "from people": runs A and B of phase 2 independently could not place Neural Latents Benchmark without overriding a test, and the characteristic always turned on the ASKING, never on the species

column1: program-computed
column4: the values are computed by a program none of whose value-determining parameters were fitted to data
column5: there is code that emits the values, and every constant in it was stated by a person or drawn from a declared distribution
column6: fails if any value-determining parameter was fitted and non-interpretable (model-generated); fails if the values were read off an instrument or authored
column7: MuJoCo and Brax rollouts; Atari and Procgen frames; PDEBench solver outputs; CMIP6 climate runs; dSprites factor grids; Dyck-k and PCFG strings; unit-test pass/fail; Lean proof checking; terminal outcomes from the rules of Go
column8: ABSORBS `simulated`, `constructed` and `rule`, all three independently, in all three referent derivations. `simulated` and `constructed` differed ONLY by referent, so deleting that clause leaves no test between them. `rule` went the same way for a sharper reason: its case for existing was itself a referent argument ("a unit test checks real code, so 'no empirical referent' is false of it"), so once `referent` takes that differentia nothing is left for it to be. D3 stated the general lesson -- a value named after the medium is always a superset of values named after kinds of that medium, and the repair is to re-cut by a production differentia, here STATED versus FITTED

column1: model-generated
column4: the values are emitted by a program at least one of whose value-determining parameters was fitted to data
column5: a trained checkpoint stands in the causal chain that produced the content, not merely scoring or filtering it
column6: model-based filtering, dedup or ranking does not count; a model consulted LIVE during the run is catalogued as a model, not as a source -- see SYNTHESIS.md section 4
column7: Self-Instruct / Alpaca; Cosmopedia; Noisy-Student pseudo-labels; AlphaFold DB predicted structures used as data; DQN replay and RL Unplugged logs
column8: the boundary with `program-computed` is now MECHANICAL -- fitted versus stated -- which is the one cut all three referent runs reached independently. Still open, and D2 placed it precisely: a 2x2 of (fitted / not) x (originates / judges) whose empty fourth cell is exactly the model-based SELECTOR question phase 1 left open (FineWeb-Edu, DataComp). The missing cut is "originates versus judges", and it is missing identically across every producer, which is what makes it an axis rather than a value repair

column1: provenance-other
column4: a production mechanism none of the above describes
column5: a reviewer can say what produced the values and why no value fits
column6: not the case where the paper does not say -- that is the `unknown` coding state
column7: none named on purpose; D3's unplaceable candidates were normative standards and counterfactual scenarios; C of phase 2 offered "the output of a learning run" for Design-Bench weight vectors, which `model-generated` does not cover because no model emitted them
column8: EXPECTED TO EMPTY under this rewrite, and all three referent runs volunteered that as a cost: machine telemetry moves to `measured`, which was where it belonged. That does NOT disarm the byproduct-of-operation watch, because its instrument is `operational_sweep.tsv`'s named list, not a residual on this axis. The measure/author/compute trichotomy is intended to be exhaustive over mechanisms, so this staying empty is the design working
